title: Introduction to Probability (cross-listed with MATH 425)

gradingBreakdown.component: Homeworks (11 assigned, lowest dropped, best 10 counted)

workloadNotes: 11 homework assignments (lowest dropped), one closed-book midterm covering chapters 1-3, one closed-book comprehensive final exam. Late homework not accepted absent documented emergency; collaboration on discussion allowed but write-ups must be independent.
prerequisitesText: MATH 215 (calculus: differentiation, integration, change of variables).
textbooks: Sheldon Ross, A First Course in Probability, 9th edition
